description: This file contains integration tests for the BankApp project, specifically checking the health endpoints, API documentation, Swagger UI, and H2 console accessibility over HTTP. It verifies server responses and redirects without starting the server, ensuring that deployed endpoints are functioning as expected.

classes.name: EndpointChecksIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 integration test class that performs HTTP checks against running BankApp endpoints for health, API docs, Swagger UI, and H2 console.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for testing, preferring environment variable over default.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path or URL with optional Accept headers.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Determines if a status code indicates an HTTP redirect.

methods.name: followRedirectOnce
methods.description: Follows a single redirect response, asserting presence of Location header, and returning the subsequent response.

methods.name: healthzReturnsOkJson
methods.description: Tests that the /healthz endpoint returns HTTP 200 with expected JSON payload.

methods.name: actuatorHealthReportsUpStatus
methods.description: Checks that the /actuator/health endpoint reports status 'UP'.

methods.name: openApiDocsContainOpenApiFieldOrSkipIfSwagger2
methods.description: Verifies that the API documentation contains an 'openapi' field, or skips if it's a Swagger 2.x document.

methods.name: swaggerUiIsReachable
methods.description: Ensures that the Swagger UI HTML page is reachable and contains the expected content.

methods.name: h2ConsoleIsReachable
methods.description: Checks that the H2 console page is accessible and contains the expected content.
